test_cases.summary:

when the user is on Create User Group popup/form
test_cases.description:

Given the user is on Create User Group popup/form
When the user leaves Group Name field empty
And clicks Save
Then the system should block submission
And show toast message “Name is required”
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block submission
The behavior should be validated when the user leaves Group Name field empty.
